description: Design screen coverage policy. Every route from the generated route inventory must be contracted, aliased to a canonical design surface, planned for future design-parity work, or explicitly excluded from baseline design parity. The schema admits planned as a lifecycle value, but the zero-debt UI composition gate accepts no planned route: rendered routes must be contracted or excluded with typed owners, and redirect-only routes must be aliases.
